headline: Pawney Kit
title: Aniimo Pawney Skills | Pursuit and Weakening Slam | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Pawney is a top damage dealer, and its kit rewards control. Its Pursuit trait adds extra damage against targets that are controlled or in a Break state. Weakening Slam allows up to three smashes in a row, and the third one stuns. Shadow Cut then spins Pawney as a blade ball for big damage. Its ultimate can be recast for Dragon Slayer Strike. Would you play Pawney? Comment below!

scenes.sub: More damage to controlled and Break targets
